{
  "subtype": "exploratory_data_analysis",
  "focus_variable": "label_pos",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "service_staff_conduct",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Well-separated interpretable categories (friendly, rude, indifferent, unprofessional) capturing a distinct review theme that can be segmented and compared against sentiment."
    },
    {
      "name": "food_quality_signal",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Ordinal, human-readable quality scale (excellent to inedible) representing an external thematic dimension well-suited to cross-tabulation with label_pos."
    },
    {
      "name": "food_praised_highlight",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Interpretable categories of what food aspect is praised; a bit skewed toward not_present but still offers meaningful positive-theme segmentation."
    },
    {
      "name": "atmosphere_ambiance_signal",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Distinct ambiance theme with interpretable polarity categories; heavily dominated by not_present (197) which weakens comparison power but categories remain meaningful."
    },
    {
      "name": "return_recommend_intent",
      "role": "predictor",
      "is_predictor": true,
      "is_interpretable_segmentation": true,
      "rationale": "Behavioral-intent categories (return yes/no, warn others) that are highly interpretable and strongly relatable to sentiment differences."
    }
  ],
  "n_predictors": 5,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.85,
  "rationale": "All five columns are external, thematic, associational variables with well-separated, human-interpretable categories that directly enable grouping and comparison against positive/negative sentiment, exactly matching the query about review themes. None merely restate the label, and none are opaque scores. The main weakness is that several columns are dominated by a 'not_present' value (especially atmosphere and food_praised_highlight), which thins the comparison base for some categories, but the remaining categories are still informative and well-defined."
}
